3 · Formation (add / remove normal carriages)
EDGE-TO-EDGE SPACING (PX) · SAVED & USED IN GAME

Spacing is measured from the real sprite edges. Moving a car (drag, X, arrows) updates these values; purchased Normal cars always reuse Normal 1 → Normal 2. Extra Normal entries follow that spacing.

4 · Save & transfer

Designs and PNGs stay in this browser. Export a JSON package to move a train to another device. "Apply to game" also saves, and the train reloads automatically next time.
